what: split a thin-walled cup (shell of a d30 cylinder) with a surface body: an extruded spline surface, extended at both ends
method: cup = cylinder r15 h30 shelled 1 mm inward with its top removed: V = pi*15^2*30 - pi*14^2*29 = 3349.04. The surface crosses the whole cup from above its rim to below its floor, so it splits the cup in two; splitting only divides material: two valid bodies whose volumes add up to 3349.04; the surface body that cut it stays, a third body
